title: ilex pedunculosa var. senjoensis
intro: Ilex pedunculosa var. senjoensis, commonly known as Japanese Holly, is a type of evergreen shrub native to East Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, possibly aiding in the prevention of various diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antiviral and antitumor activities, suggesting its potential in treating a range of conditions. Bioactive constituents of Ilex pedunculosa var. senjoensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
